name: Great Harbour Deep
text: Great Harbour Deep was an incorporated town in the province of Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada, situated on the east coast of the Great Northern Peninsula, in White Bay inlet. Harbour Deep, as it is customarily called, is a logging and fishing community that lies at the head of Pigeonnière Arm. It was once known as Orange Bay or Baie L'Orange.

depictions.name: Harbour Deep
depictions.text: Great Harbour Deep Harbour Deep was a fishing community in the province of Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada. During the mid-18th century, Harbour Deep was a largely uninhabited region, with its mountaineus terrain primarily populated by foxes and black bears. It also featured a hunting lodge, which was initially occupied by gang members, before being freed from their control and then renovated by the Templar Shay Cormac.
